description: Source file defining the FDistribution class, implementing the F-distribution statistical distribution with methods for probability density, cumulative distribution, moments, support bounds, and variance calculations.

classes.name: FDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the F-distribution with methods for probability calculations and distribution properties.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given value x.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given value x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given value x.

methods.name: getNumeratorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the numerator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getDenominatorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the denominator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution if defined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution if defined.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Computes the variance based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (always infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates support lower bound inclusivity (always false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates support upper bound inclusivity (always false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (always true).
